# Page title

Save the page in the section it belongs to (e.g. backend/, reference/), never at the root of docs/. A new
section is a new folder with an index.md: its title is the sidebar label and its body is the landing page.

Write for a developer using Inithium: what it is, how to use it, with code where it helps. Link to the decision
records that explain why.
